Eating it will restore some hearts and cool you down, but don't break your teeth on it.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Frozen Bird Thighs are a type of [[Frozen Food]], and they can be made by chilling [[Raw Bird Thigh]]s in a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} They are frozen solid, which makes them difficult to eat. Eating one will restore one and a half [[Heart]]s and grant [[Link]] temporary [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Frozen Bird Thighs return in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Frozen Food]], and they can be made by exposing [[Raw Bird Thigh]]s to a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]]. They have been made difficult to eat by being frozen solid. If [[Link]] eats a Frozen Bird Thigh, he will heal one and a half [[Heart]]s and gain temporary [[Heat Resistance]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Frozen Bird Drumstick * Frozen Food * Frozen Whole Bird * Raw Bird Thigh * Roasted Bird Thigh }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Frozen Food, Meats, Health Restoring Items |items= BotW, TotK }}
